dLGtmN05uMkIx5kw2QNrUw.zh: 薩摩亞疫情持續,近1週(4/20-26)報告159例病例,其中27例確診,自2025年1月迄今累計18,559例臨床診斷病例及5,386例確診病例。主要流行型別為DENV-1(57%)及DENV-2(43%),15歲以下兒童為主要受影響族群。 東加自今年4/17宣布疫情爆發迄今累計報告56例確診病例,自5/4以來新增3例病例,病例主要分布於湯加塔布島,主要流行型別為DENV-2,11-14歲男性為主要受影響族群。
dLGtmN05uMkIx5kw2QNrUw.en: Samoa's outbreak continues: in the most recent week (20–26 April), 159 cases were reported, of which 27 were confirmed. Since January 2025, 18,559 clinically diagnosed cases and 5,386 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively. The main circulating serotypes are DENV-1 (57%) and DENV-2 (43%), and children under 15 are the main affected group. Tonga declared an outbreak on 17 April this year. Cumulatively, 56 confirmed cases have been reported, with three new cases since 4 May, mainly on Tongatapu Island. The main serotype is DENV-2, and males aged 11–14 are the main affected group.

jETZM7T60T8Bv8NsFzxETA.zh: 薩摩亞近期報告1例7個月大嬰兒死亡病例,1/26-2/2新增56例病例,自去年迄今已累計16,842例病例及8例死亡,主要流行型別為DENV-1。
jETZM7T60T8Bv8NsFzxETA.en: Samoa has recently reported one death of a 7-month-old infant. From 26 January to 2 February, 56 new cases were reported, and since last year, 16,842 cases and 8 deaths have been reported cumulatively. The main circulating serotype is DENV-1.

Ou0a538-uuJAAdxq9IEX1A.zh: 諾魯爆發疫情,今年截至8/18累計379例病例,7/30報告2例死亡病例,77%病例為18歲以下者,病例主要分布於梅嫩區、代戈莫杜區、愛和區、博埃區及拜齊區。 薩摩亞疫情更新,今年截至8/17累計3,070例確診病例及6例死亡,91%病例來自烏波盧島,主要檢出型別為DENV-1。
Ou0a538-uuJAAdxq9IEX1A.en: Nauru has an outbreak: as of 18 August this year, 379 cases had been cumulatively reported, and two deaths were reported on 30 July. 77% of cases are aged 18 or under. Cases are mainly distributed in Meneng, Denigomodu, Aiwo, Boe and Baiti districts. Samoa's outbreak update: as of 17 August this year, 3,070 confirmed cases and six deaths had been cumulatively reported. 91% of cases came from Upolu Island, and the main serotype detected is DENV-1.

blwGXBlj5kcor4-Pl0H4oQ.zh: 薩摩亞疫情上升,近1週(7/21-27)報告521例病例,該國自4/17宣布爆發疫情以來已累計2,277例確診病例及2例死亡病例。91%病例來自烏波盧島,且以15歲以下人口族群為主(71%),當局為控制疫情,宣布所有學校停課一週並進行消毒。
blwGXBlj5kcor4-Pl0H4oQ.en: Samoa's outbreak is rising: in the past week (21–27 July), 521 cases were reported. Since Samoa declared the outbreak on 17 April, 2,277 confirmed cases and two deaths have been cumulatively reported. 91% of cases came from Upolu Island, and 71% of cases are among people aged under 15. To control the outbreak, authorities have announced that all schools will close for one week and carry out disinfection.

iQcC5BSm30SmB8Vfd9IKNg.zh: 薩摩亞疫情上升,近1週(7/7-13)報告331例病例,累計1,276例病例及2例死亡,病例主要來自烏波盧島,以阿庇亞及烏波盧島西北部地區為多,10%病例住院治療,主要檢出型別為DENV-1。
iQcC5BSm30SmB8Vfd9IKNg.en: Dengue is rising in Samoa. In the most recent week (7–13 July), 331 cases were reported, bringing the cumulative total to 1,276 cases and 2 deaths. Cases are mainly from Upolu Island, concentrated in Apia and the northwest of Upolu. 10% of cases were hospitalized, and the main serotype detected is DENV-1.

zr3cVzPVwMzfrCITJfqo6Q.zh: 薩摩亞宣布爆發疫情,今年迄今累計報告36例病例及1例死亡,病例主要分布於烏波盧島,以15-19歲族群為多,目前檢出流行型別為DENV-2及DENV-1,當局已採取相關防治措施。
zr3cVzPVwMzfrCITJfqo6Q.en: Samoa has announced an outbreak. So far this year, 36 cases and 1 death have been reported cumulatively, mainly on Upolu Island, with most cases among people aged 15–19. The circulating serotypes detected are DENV-2 and DENV-1. Authorities have taken related prevention and control measures.
